purpose: Controlled COMBINED experiment: the official no-repeat n-gram suppression (size 35, trailing window 1024 over generated ids only) at RAISED output budgets 12288 then 16384, on the same four frozen P2-A documents whose ngram=0 and ngram=35@8192 evidence is immutable. Controls are never re-run or overwritten. No 39321 escalation and no 30/50/100-page escalation is authorized by this policy. Production defaults are NOT changed: the production cap stays 8192 and suppression stays opt-in off.
baseline_evidence: P2-B ledger run 6e1ae22e (ngram=35/window=1024 @8192) and the immutable ngram=0 P1.5/P2-A evidence; never rewritten
budget_policy: eval/experiments/p2a-token-budget/policy.json — the budget source of truth, presented to validate_budget at run time
ngram_scope: generated tokens only (official SGLang SGLANG_UOCR_NGRAM_OUTPUT_ONLY=True semantics; frozen model loop scans gen only)
ngram_provenance: official client infer.py@48ff432 (docs/rca/NGRAM35_SOURCE_AUDIT.md); guard-collision safety revalidated in docs/validation/P2C_GUARD_COLLISION_SAFETY.md

admission.rule: pages*prompt_upper_bound + budget + margin must not exceed context_cap_tokens

stage_admission.rule: budget 16384 runs only if the 12288 stage completed all four documents with zero forced-marker mismatches, zero TIMEOUT/OOM/CRASH outcomes, GPU peak allocated within max_gpu_peak_allocated_gib, host peak RSS within max_host_peak_rss_gib, and both policy digests still matching the run identity

supervision.worker: isolated subprocess per attempt (P1.5 supervision); workers persist token ids for replay
